svg.title: Disciplined $10,000 digital product launch allocation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-zero-cogs-startup-stack; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Disciplined $10,000 digital product launch allocation; subtitle: Illustrative pilot budget with 50% untouched cash reserve; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD; four additive components total $10,000 for a multi-SKU launch scenario. Serverless hosting and startup credits keep fixed tech COGS near zero.; caption: Never sink $10,000 into unvalidated course production; cap initial build + legal setup and preserve liquidity for post-validation traffic scaling.; stages: label: Entity & IP setup; value: $1,200; numeric value: 1200.0; detail: LLC formation, business banking, domain portfolio, and contractor work-made-for-hire / IP templates.; label: Design & tooling; value: $1,300; numeric value: 1300.0; detail: Screen-recording gear, analytics, email engine, and modular design assets not covered by free tiers.; label: Validation ad tests; value: $2,500; numeric value: 2500.0; detail: Bounded 72-hour pre-sale smoke tests and SLO creative experiments with strict kill gates.; label: Operating reserve; value: $5,000; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Untouched liquidity buffer for scaling proven ROAS winners and covering payout timing.
